correctness.rationale: The natural cubic interpolant on knots 0,1,2,3 has M0=M3=0 and a 2×2 interior-curvature matrix [[4,1],[1,4]] with exact right sides 6 second differences. Since the spline operator is linear and preserves constants, data differences decompose uniquely into three binary step inputs; the exact induced variation norm is maximum of their three output variations. For the central step (0,0,1,1), M1=2,M2=−2 and derivative polynomials u²−1/3,2/3+2u−2u²,(1−u)²−1/3 give total variation 1+8/(9sqrt(3)). The reflected outer steps have exact smaller gain 133/125+4sqrt(3)/135+52sqrt(39)/3375. Thus all real 4-point data satisfy the sharp inequality, central step saturates; the same norm bounds two-input differences by linearity. Independently checked rational curvatures, roots and integral variations plus 200 random rational inputs.
